properveinminer.config.title: Proper Vein Miner and Lumberjack
properveinminer.config.activation.tip: When it works: unless you sneak (sneak to break one block), only while sneaking, or always.
properveinminer.config.protect_tool.tip: Stop before the tool's last durability point, so it never breaks.
properveinminer.config.gather_drops.tip: All drops and experience appear at the first block.
properveinminer.config.max_blocks.tip: The most blocks broken at once, the first one included.
properveinminer.config.mix_variants.tip: Deepslate and stone variants of an ore are one vein.
properveinminer.config.require_leaves.ti: Only fell logs with natural leaves next to them (trees, not houses).
properveinminer.config.only_upwards.tip: Never break logs below the one you cut.
properveinminer.config.extra_ores.tip: Block ids that count as ores too, separated by commas, e.g. somemod:ruby_cluster
properveinminer.config.excluded_ores.tip: Block ids that are never vein mined, separated by commas.
properveinminer.config.extra_logs.tip: Block ids that count as logs too, separated by commas.
properveinminer.config.excluded_logs.tip: Block ids that are never felled, separated by commas.
properveinminer.config.controls.tip: The on / off keys (look for "Proper Vein Miner"). Default: ` for both.
